title: Inheritance Tax vs Estate Tax: What Most Families Don’t Know
bigPicture: Estate tax is paid by the estate before money goes to heirs; inheritance tax is paid by the person who receives the money.
whatYouNeedToKnow: The estate tax is taken from the total value of everything the person owned before it is split up.
The inheritance tax is taken from each person’s share after they get it.
Not every state has these taxes, and the federal government only has an estate tax for very large estates.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Thinking you owe tax just because you got an inheritance — many people owe nothing.
Forgetting to check your state’s rules, because they can be very different from federal rules.
actionSteps: Ask a trusted tax professional or lawyer to review the estate’s value and your state’s laws.
Keep good records of what you receive and any taxes paid, so you have proof if questions come up later.
